notes: Read the source file line by line before editing. The default-exported RouteEfficiencyPage, the RouteCard sub-component, the efficiencyVariant helper, every state name (vehicleId/vehicleIdStr/startDate/endDate/data/isLoading/error/unitPrefs/distanceUnit/efficiencyUnit/routes/totalTrips/bestEff/worstEff/avgEff/chartData), the API path (GET /analytics/route-efficiency via useRouteEfficiency(vehicleIdStr, startDate, endDate)), the SI unit handling (avgEfficiency/bestEfficiency/worstEfficiency Wh/km, avgDistanceKm km; *1.609344 for Wh/mi, convertDistanceFromSI for km/mi), and all i18n keys are preserved verbatim.
L1 import {useMemo} -> useMemo preserved; useCallback/useEffect/useRef/useState added for the inlined hooks + AnimatedNumber count-up.

L2 react-i18next useTranslation -> inlined native useTranslation(): t(key, fallback?) returns the English fallback (or key); no i18n runtime in the parity bundle, every key preserved at the call site (RouteCard calls useTranslation() internally exactly like the source L51).

L3 lucide-react {MapPin, ArrowRight, TrendingUp, Activity} -> native glyphs: IconBox+MapPin collapse onto <SemanticIcon name="mapPinned" size="sm"> (accent/cyan tile, matching IconBox color="cyan"); ArrowRight -> a muted ' → ' AppText between start/end; TrendingUp -> an accent '↗' glyph in the Route Metrics title; Activity -> <SemanticIcon name="activity" size="lg"> as the EmptyState icon. No SVG/DOM icon library is imported.

L4 PageContainer from @/components/layout -> inlined native PageContainer (header title/subtitle/actions + ScrollView; loading -> ActivityIndicator, error -> error box, else children), preserving the title/subtitle/error/loading={isLoading} props passed at L149-165.
L5 GlassPanel from @/components/ui -> the ported native ../../../../components/ui/GlassPanel (the hover/glow="cyan"/cursor-pointer DOM affordances have no native analog and are dropped).

L6 Badge from @/components/ui -> inlined native Badge pill; BADGE_PALETTE maps success/warning/danger to the successSurface/warningSurface/dangerSurface + matching foreground theme tokens, and info to an explicit blue (no blue surface token) mirroring the web blue-100/blue-800 chip. variant comes from efficiencyVariant(route.avgEfficiency) at the same call site (L70).
L7 IconBox from @/components/ui -> folded into <SemanticIcon name="mapPinned"> (a colored icon tile == IconBox+icon), so the standalone IconBox import is unnecessary.

L8 VehicleSelect, RangePicker from @/components/forms -> RangePicker is the ported native ../../../components/forms/RangePicker (value {start,end}, onChange(value), align 'end', triggerTestId 'route-efficiency-range-picker' all preserved); the prop-less <VehicleSelect/> is inlined as an option-chip Select wired to the page-owned useSelectedVehicle (vehicleId/vehicles/setVehicleId) because RN cannot share the web hook's prop-less selection store across instances.

L9 useUrlString, useUrlBatch from @/hooks/useUrlState -> in-memory useState for startDate/endDate + a setRangeBatch({from,to}) callback (RN has no browser URL/search params); the source only reads [startDate]/[endDate] and the RangePicker still calls setRangeBatch({from:r.start,to:r.end}) exactly as L158.

L10-13 ChartContainer/ChartTooltip + Recharts BarChart/Bar/XAxis/YAxis/CartesianGrid/Tooltip/ResponsiveContainer from @/components/charts -> ChartContainer is the already-ported native ../../../components/charts (keeps title/ariaLabel/data/dataColumns/height + the exportable data table); the vertical-layout grouped BarChart (best/avg/worst per route) collapses onto an inlined native RouteComparisonChart of horizontal grouped bars with the identical #10b981/#00f0ff/#ef4444 fills (L219-221) and a colour legend. No Recharts/ResponsiveContainer/Tooltip primitives are imported.

L14 AnimatedNumber from @/components/data-display -> inlined canonical native AnimatedNumber: a requestAnimationFrame ease-out-quad (1-(1-p)^2) count-up from 0 to value over 1s rendering fmtNumber(display, 0) with tabular-nums; reduce-motion jumps to the final value and the rAF is cancelled on unmount (no dangling timer under --detectOpenHandles).

L15 MetricBar from @/components/data-display -> inlined native MetricBar (label + colored sublabel ?? fmtNumber(value) readout above a track/fill capped at 100%); the framer 1s grow tween collapses to a static fill, the value semantics preserved.
L16 EmptyState from @/components/feedback -> the ported native ../../../components/feedback/EmptyState (icon + message); the no-action comment and common.noData key are preserved (L269-273).

L17 FadeIn from @/components/motion -> the ported native ../../../components/motion/FadeIn wrapping the summary panel, the comparison chart, each route card, and the metrics panel (same sections as the source).

L18-19 StaggerContainer/StaggerItem from @/components/motion -> the grid container becomes a vertical View (styles.routeCardsStack) and each StaggerItem becomes a <FadeIn delay={i*0.06}> (mirroring the web staggerChildren 0.06), honoring reduce motion; the StaggerItem key `${startLocation}-${endLocation}` is preserved (L231).

L20 useRouteEfficiency from @/api/hooks/useDriving -> the already-ported native ../../../api/hooks/useDriving (same (vehicleId?, start?, end?) signature, same ['route-efficiency', vehicleId, start, end] query key, same GET /analytics/route-efficiency?vehicle_id=&start=&end= path).

L21 useSelectedVehicle from @/hooks/useSelectedVehicle -> inlined native useSelectedVehicle over the ported useVehicles(): keeps the web hook's final 'first vehicle is the default' precedence in local state; the page reads vehicleId (-> vehicleIdStr) and threads vehicles/setVehicleId into the inlined Select.

L22 AIRouteEfficiencySuggestions from @/components/ai -> the already-ported native ../../../components/ai/AIRouteEfficiencySuggestions named export, rendered with vehicleId={vehicleIdStr} above the comparison chart (L196), with the source's comment block preserved.

L23 useUnits from @/hooks/useUnits -> inlined native useUnits() that derives unitPrefs.distance from the ported useSettings() unit_of_length ('mi' => 'mi', else 'km') exactly like the web deriveDistance; the page only reads unitPrefs.distance, so just that field is surfaced and the unitPrefs.distance call sites (L122/L124/L125/L126) are preserved verbatim.
L24 usePageTitle from @/hooks/usePageTitle -> inlined native no-op (RN has no document.title); the call site + translated routeEfficiency.title key are preserved (L105).

L25 fmtNumber, fmtInt from @/lib/numberFormat -> inlined faithfully (locale-aware fixed-decimal, non-finite -> 0, default precision 2, bad-locale en-US fallback; fmtInt = fmtNumber(_,0)). RN ships no global number-format locale singleton, so en-US is used (the web default before settings configure it); every call site keeps the source's argument list.

L26 type RouteSummary from @/types/driving -> imported as a type from the ported ../../../api/hooks/useDriving (same camelCase shape: startLocation/endLocation/tripCount/avgDistanceKm/avgEfficiency/bestEfficiency/worstEfficiency).
L27 convertDistanceFromSI from @/lib/unitConversion -> inlined (meters/1000 km, meters/1609.344 mi); used via toDistanceDisplay (L122) exactly as the source.
L33-38 efficiencyVariant(eff): <140 success, <180 info, <220 warning, else danger -> ported verbatim as a module-level function returning the EfficiencyVariant union.

L44-97 RouteCard: ported with route/efficiencyUnit/distanceUnit/toDistanceDisplay/toEfficiencyDisplay props; avgEff/bestEff/worstEff = toEfficiencyDisplay(route.*) (L52-54); the header shows the mapPinned tile + 'start → end' (L62-64) + the '{tripCount} trips · {fmtNumber(toDistanceDisplay(avgDistanceKm*1000))} {distanceUnit} avg' caption (L65-67) + the Badge (efficiencyVariant(avgEfficiency), fmtInt(avgEff)+unit) (L70-72).

L75-89 RouteCard efficiency bar: the web linear-gradient (green 0->bestPct, cyan bestPct->avgPct, red avgPct->100 where pct = display/Max(worst,1)*100) is reproduced as three flex segments inside the rounded track, followed by the best(green)/avg(cyan)/worst(red) fmtInt readouts (L85-87); segment widths are clamped >=0.
L90-94 RouteCard Best/Avg/Worst caption row -> a justify-end row of three muted captions with the same routeEfficiency.best/avgLabel/worst keys.
L103-105 RouteEfficiencyPage export + useTranslation + usePageTitle(t('routeEfficiency.title','Route Efficiency')) -> preserved (typed React.ReactElement).

L107-108 useSelectedVehicle().vehicleId + vehicleIdStr = vehicleId!=null?String(vehicleId):undefined -> preserved verbatim; the page also threads vehicles/setVehicleId into the inlined Select (vehicleOptions = display_name||vin).

L110-118 defaultStartDate (today-30, ISO yyyy-mm-dd) + defaultEndDate (today) useMemos, [startDate]/[endDate] from useUrlString, setRangeBatch from useUrlBatch -> preserved; useUrlString/useUrlBatch collapse to useState(default*) + a setRangeBatch({from,to}) callback driving the query.

L120-126 useRouteEfficiency(vehicleIdStr, startDate, endDate) + useUnits() + toDistanceDisplay + distanceUnit + efficiencyUnit ('Wh/mi'|'Wh/km') + toEfficiencyDisplay (whPerKm*1.609344 for mi) -> preserved verbatim (KM_PER_MILE 1.609344 constant).

L128-132 routes = data?.routes ?? []; totalTrips ΣtripCount; bestEff = min(bestEfficiency); worstEff = max(worstEfficiency); avgEff = mean(avgEfficiency) -> preserved verbatim (order-independent reductions).

L135-146 chartData useMemo: routes.sort((a,b)=>a.avgEfficiency-b.avgEfficiency).slice(0,10).map(...) building {name (start→end 10-char substrings), avg/best/worst rounded toEfficiencyDisplay, trips} -> preserved verbatim including the in-place sort (so the route cards + Most-Driven metric render in avgEfficiency-ascending order exactly like the web); the [routes, toEfficiencyDisplay] deps + per-render recompute are preserved (exhaustive-deps suppressed since toEfficiencyDisplay is intentionally recreated each render to mirror the source).

L148-165 PageContainer(title/subtitle/error/loading={isLoading}, actions = VehicleSelect + RangePicker) -> the inlined native PageContainer; actions render the option-chip Select (only when vehicles exist) + the native RangePicker (value/onChange/align/triggerTestId preserved).

L166-188 Summary stats FadeIn>GlassPanel: a 4-up grid of AnimatedNumber (routes.length accent, totalTrips primary, round(toEfficiencyDisplay(bestEff)) success, round(toEfficiencyDisplay(avgEff)) warning) each over an uppercase caption (routeEfficiency.routes/totalTrips/bestEfficiency/avgEfficiency with efficiencyUnit) -> ported; cyan-400/green-400/amber-400 map to colors.accent/success/warning theme tokens; on phone the 2/4-col grid collapses to 2 columns.
L190-196 AI suggestions comment block + <AIRouteEfficiencySuggestions vehicleId={vehicleIdStr}/> -> preserved verbatim above the comparison chart.

L198-226 comparison chart, gated on chartData.length > 1: FadeIn>ChartContainer(title routeEfficiency.comparison, ariaLabel routeEfficiency.comparison.aria, data mapped to {name,best,avg,worst}, the 4 dataColumns, height 260) wrapping the native RouteComparisonChart; the Recharts BarChart/Bar (best #10b981 / avg #00f0ff / worst #ef4444) collapses onto horizontal grouped bars + legend, and the ChartContainer keeps the exportable data table from the same data/dataColumns.

L228-241 StaggerContainer grid of RouteCards -> a routeCardsStack View; each route maps to <FadeIn delay={i*0.06}> wrapping <RouteCard .../> with the same key and the same five props (route/efficiencyUnit/distanceUnit/toDistanceDisplay/toEfficiencyDisplay).

L243-276 Route Metrics FadeIn>GlassPanel: the '↗ Route Metrics' title (L246-248), then routes.length>0 ? a 4-up MetricBar grid (Best/Avg/Worst Efficiency with max 300/300/400 and #10b981/#00f0ff/#ef4444 + the fmtInt(value)+unit caption, and Most Driven Route value routes[0]?.tripCount ?? 0, max Math.max(routes[0]?.tripCount ?? 1, 20), color #a855f7 + the '{tripCount} trips' caption) : the EmptyState (Activity icon + common.noData), no-action comment preserved.

L277-279 close PageContainer / component -> preserved (native ScrollView + sectionStack close). No DOM elements, react-i18next, framer-motion, Recharts, Leaflet, react-dom, or web UI-kit modules are imported into the native output. Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck; npm run lint -- --quiet; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
